**35% reduction in cloud costs while scaling backend infrastructure for 1M+ users**  

As a Senior Backend Engineer at NexGen Technologies, I’ve spent the last five years building and maintaining high-performance systems for enterprise clients. My work revolves around balancing innovation with reliability, ensuring scalable solutions that meet stringent SLA requirements. I thrive in environments where complex challenges demand both technical precision and strategic thinking—whether it’s optimizing database queries to handle millions of transactions or designing APIs that integrate seamlessly with legacy systems.  

My expertise spans full-stack backend development, with a focus on cloud-native architectures. I’ve led projects to reduce AWS spending by 35% through automated cost governance, while also improving PostgreSQL query performance by 40% via index optimization and query restructuring. Containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes form the backbone of our microservices architecture, enabling rapid deployment and seamless scaling. I also leverage Terraform to streamline infrastructure as code, ensuring consistency across environments. My proficiency in Go and Python allows me to craft efficient services, while REST API design remains a cornerstone of my daily work.  

Let’s connect and explore how we can collaborate on solving complex technical challenges—or simply share insights on building resilient, scalable systems.
